articles.title: Show HN: Eulix – Local code index and call graphs for large repos, LLM optional
articles.summary: Managing large software codebases presents a challenge in locating specific information. Traditional tools like Grep find strings, while Language Server Protocols (LSPs) require symbol knowledge. However, Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising solution. They can confidently answer complex code queries even without explicit prior knowledge, significantly streamlining software development, debugging, and problem-solving in modern tech.

articles.title: ‘Whalefall’ Review: Austin Abrams Gets Swallowed by a Whale in an Unintentionally Preposterous Thriller — a Tale of Human Perseverance and Mammalian Stomach Lining
articles.summary: “Whalefall,” an undersea thriller, attempts to emulate “Jaws” for whales but reportedly fails, receiving a poor critical reception. The review compares it negatively to “Howard the Duck,” indicating a lack of effectiveness or quality. This highlights the importance of critical evaluation, even in entertainment, for a balanced perspective, relevant for SSB aspirants assessing various topics.

articles.title: I do not have confidence UK is safe from Russian threats - Swinney
articles.summary: The First Minister, responding to MI5 chief's comments, expressed deep worry about a "lack of coastal and offshore protection," singling out waters north of Shetland as a critical vulnerability. This concern underscores significant national security and maritime defence gaps, prompting calls for enhanced protective measures to safeguard vital offshore interests and national security.
